setup: if [ -n "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH" ] && [ -d "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/vendor/sol-pi" ]; then git clone --quiet "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/vendor/sol-pi" vendor/sol-pi && git -C vendor/sol-pi checkout --quiet "$(git ls-tree HEAD vendor/sol-pi | awk '{print $3}')"; else git submodule update --init --recursive; fi
